title: Swidget's TAS
description: Swidget’s TAS is a Minecraft 1.21.11 Java Edition mod that adds Tool-Assisted Speedrunning (TAS) features to the game. Slow down gameplay for precision, then replay it at full speed on command.
body: Swidget’s TAS is a Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11 mod designed for Tool-Assisted Speedrunning (TAS). The mod allows players to slow down gameplay for more precise movement, inputs, and timing, then replay actions at normal or faster speeds on command. It is useful for TAS practice, movement testing, challenge runs, and creating smooth replay-style gameplay clips directly in Minecraft.
